text: Still no official results as of 22:40. Results trackers show 0% of ballot boxes reported; the first official figures usually come out after midnight.
Netanyahu says Likud won the most votes according to the exit polls.
Eisenkot calls the exit polls a win for Israel's mainstream majority and pledges to replace Netanyahu with a Zionist government.
No official results yet. Results sites show 0% of ballot boxes reported; the official count usually starts appearing after midnight.
Kan 11 exit poll: Likud 25, Yashar 21, B'Yachad 14, Joint List 10, Democrats 10. Netanyahu bloc 50, Zionist opposition 53, Arab parties 17.
Channel 13 exit poll: Likud 25, Yashar 23. The anti-Netanyahu side reaches 70 only when the 17 Arab-party seats are included.
Channel 12 exit poll: Likud 24, Yashar 22, B'Yachad 12, Joint List 11. Netanyahu bloc 50, opposition 52, Arab parties a record 18. Reservists and People of Israel miss the threshold.
Turnout reaches 74.3% at 20:00, already above the 2022 election's final total.
